$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

telegraphDelayDefaultMs.description: Telegraph delay used when a threat declares `telegraphDelayMs: null`, in ms (GDD §1: 0.8 to 1.5 s per threat).

perfectMs.description: Perfect-response window, centred in the response window, in ms.

toleranceMs.description: Hidden tolerance added on each side of the window, in ms (GDD §1).

bufferMs.description: Input buffer: a press this early before the window is kept, in ms (GDD §1).

hitstopMs.description: Real-time freeze on a successful or perfect response, in real ms (GDD §1).

timeScale.description: Sim speed during the slow-mo (1 = normal, 0.3 = 30 % speed, never below 0.05).

durationMs.description: How long the slow-mo holds, in **sim** ms (ADR-002).

returnMs.description: Return to the base scale after the slow-mo, in sim ms (0 = instant).

slowMoPerfect.description: Slow-mo played on a perfect response.

timeScale.description: Sim speed during the slow-mo (1 = normal, 0.3 = 30 % speed, never below 0.05).

durationMs.description: How long the slow-mo holds, in **sim** ms (ADR-002).

returnMs.description: Return to the base scale after the slow-mo, in sim ms (0 = instant).

slowMoLastThreat.description: Slow-mo played on the last threat of a wave.

holdMinMs.description: A press released before this is a Parry, one held to or past it is a Firmness (ADR-010), in ms.

earlyPress.description: What a press before the window (minus tolerance and buffer) does to the judgement: `fail` triggers the gag, `guard` ignores it. Papa glides to the threat in both cases.

touchRadiusPx.description: Generous touch radius around a threat, in screen px (targets stay >= 44 pt).

objectTouchRadiusPx.description: Touch radius around an interactive object's icon point (coffee machine, phone), in screen px.

autoTargetConeDeg.description: Auto-target cone for keyboard and gamepad, in degrees (story 1.17).

contextReachM.description: Space or A acts on the nearest interactive object within this distance of Papa, in metres (story 1.17).

stickDeadzonePct.description: Left-stick deadzone: a push under this share of the full range is no direction, in percent.

stickAngleStepDeg.description: The left-stick direction is rounded to a multiple of this angle before it is sent, so a resting hand does not flood the journal, in degrees.

glideMaxMs.description: Papa's glide towards a target takes at most this long, in ms (GDD §3).

walkSpeedMps.description: Papa walking speed (tap on the floor, keys, stick), in metres per second.

papaRadiusM.description: Papa's half width, in metres: his centre stays this far from furniture and walls. Read once when the level starts: a `SetFeel` takes effect at the next level.

crawlSpeedMps.description: Crawling speed while wandering, in metres per second.

bodyRadiusM.description: The baby's half width, in metres: its centre stays this far from furniture and walls, and the provisional sphere has this radius. Read once when the level starts: a `SetFeel` takes effect at the next level.

babbleMinMs.description: Shortest sit-and-babble pause between two wanders, in ms; also the first pause when the level starts.

babbleMaxMs.description: Longest sit-and-babble pause between two wanders, in ms.

wanderMinDistM.description: A new wander destination is at least this far from where the baby sits, in metres.

wanderMaxDistM.description: A new wander destination is at most this far from where the baby sits, in metres.

lockMs.description: How long the baby stares at its target, still, before it sets off (`targetLocked`), in ms.

approachSpeedMps.description: Slowest approach speed towards a threat; the baby goes faster when it must to reach the target by the opening of the window, in metres per second.

actMs.description: How long the baby plays its mischief after a gag (`act`) before it babbles again, in ms.

silenceAlertMs.description: How long the hidden baby stays quiet in its zone before the silence is announced (`SilenceStarted`), in ms.

sneakSpeedMps.description: How fast the baby crawls to the hidden zone of a suspicious silence, in metres per second.

baby.description: The baby exploring the room on its own (FR15, GDD › Micro-boucle: it wanders and babbles until it spots a danger).

startPoints.description: Fatigue at the start of a level that has the fatigue gauge, in points (0-100).

perSec.description: Fatigue gained per second, in points per second.

carriedMultiplier.description: Fatigue gain multiplier while carrying the baby.

thresholdPoints.description: Above this fatigue, windows shrink and micro-sleeps start, in points.

windowPenaltyPct.description: Response windows shrink by this percentage above the threshold.

microSleepMinMs.description: Shortest delay between two micro-sleeps above the threshold, in ms.

microSleepMaxMs.description: Longest delay between two micro-sleeps above the threshold, in ms.

coffeeReductionPoints.description: Fatigue removed by a coffee, in points.

coffeeDurationMs.description: Time Papa spends drinking a coffee, in ms.

asleepMs.description: How long Papa sleeps after a missed micro-sleep, in ms.

timeScale.description: Sim speed while Fatherly Instinct is active (1 = normal).

windowBonusPct.description: Response windows grow by this percentage while active.

durationMs.description: How long the instinct lasts, in ms.

cooldownMs.description: Recharge time after the instinct ends, in ms.

minActiveThreatsCount.description: Trigger: at least this many active threats at once...

windowMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to every response window of the tier.

assistance.description: Assistance tier: wider windows, instinct on (GDD, accessibility).

windowMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to every response window of the tier.

normal.description: Normal tier: the game as designed.

windowMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to every response window of the tier.

experienced.description: Experienced-dad tier: tighter windows, no instinct.

difficulty.description: Difficulty tiers (GDD, accessibility and skill range).

laughMaxPoints.description: Most points the baby laughs can give, in points.

babyStateMaxPoints.description: Most points the baby state can give, in points.

babyStateFixedPoints.description: Baby-state points used by the prototype instead of the real computation, in points.

baseScorePoints.description: Base points added to every score, in points.

sighMaxPoints.description: Most points a sigh can take off, in points.

screamMaxPoints.description: Most points a scream can take off, in points.

starThresholdPoints.description: Score needed for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 stars, in points (0 to 100, ascending).

earlyWakePenaltyStars.description: Stars taken off when Mama wakes early, in stars.

laughPerPerfectPoints.description: Laugh points each perfect response gives (held to `laughMaxPoints`), in points per perfect.

sighPerPropOnFloorPoints.description: Sigh points each unbroken prop lying on the floor at the end takes off, in points per prop.

sighPerBrokenPropPoints.description: Sigh points each broken prop takes off, in points per prop.

sighPerMischiefPoints.description: Sigh points each surprise mischief the baby got away with takes off, in points per mischief.

screamPerNearMissPoints.description: Scream points each near miss takes off (held to `screamMaxPoints`), in points per near miss.

gravityMps2.description: Gravity pulling the props down, in metres per second squared.

impactMinImpulseNs.description: A contact impulse under this is a prop settling, not an impact: nothing is emitted, in newton-seconds.

impactCooldownMs.description: After a `PropImpact`, the same prop emits no other for this long, in sim ms.

maxPushImpulseNs.description: Largest impulse one push (a gag, the debug `PushProp`) gives a prop, in newton-seconds: a larger one is clamped to it. `content:check` holds it low enough that no kind crosses a wall of the room in one step.

shape.description: Collider shape, sized from the prop's half extents: `box` is a cuboid, `cylinder` stands on its axis (radius = the larger of x and z, half height = y), `ball` has the smallest half extent as radius.

massKg.description: Mass of one prop of this kind, in kilograms.

friction.description: Friction coefficient of the prop (0 = ice, 1 = rubber); a dimensionless ratio.

restitution.description: Bounciness (0 = stays where it lands, 1 = rebounds with all its speed); a dimensionless ratio.

breakable.description: Whether an impact of `breakImpulseNs` or more breaks the prop.

breakImpulseNs.description: Contact impulse that breaks a breakable prop, in newton-seconds. Required even when `breakable` is false, where it is not read.

additionalProperties.description: The physics of one kind of prop (`PROP_<kind>_<nn>` in the level).

kinds.description: Physics of each kind of prop, by kind (`mug` for `PROP_mug_01`).

physics.description: Light physics of the props (GDD §11, story 1.15): falls, bounces, impacts and breakage.

pushImpulseNs.description: Impulse the coffee-table gag gives the object on the table, in newton-seconds, horizontally away from the anchor (held to `physics.maxPushImpulseNs`).

propReachDistM.description: How far from the threat anchor, in metres (horizontal), an object that is off the floor still counts as « on the table ».

tableObjectFall.description: The gag of the object on the coffee table (story 1.16).

gags.description: Tunables of the gags whose consequence the sim applies (`sim/threats/gags.ts`); a gag with nothing to tune has no key.

description: Every feel value of the game, tuned by hand or from the feel panel.
